title: A selection across a wide block copies only the columns on screen
body:
Drag selection (c813ecf) copies the text the last draw recorded for each row. A code block or table wider than the transcript pans, so only its visible columns are drawn, and a selection that crosses it copies those columns and drops the rest of each line. A drag that starts inside such a block selects nothing.

## Proposal

When a selection covers a whole row of a wide block, the copy takes the block's full line, not the visible window. A selection that starts and ends inside one row of the block keeps the visible columns.
